key_insight: OpenPVMapper builds the first open, nationwide, installation-level database of rooftop PV systems in mainland France by merging multiple complementary detection sources.
engineering_relevance: The dataset supports grid planning, solar resource analysis, and large-scale PV adoption studies by providing location-level rooftop PV inventory with provenance and validation metadata.
method: Deep learning detection on nationwide aerial imagery
Reconciliation with OpenStreetMap and a probabilistic building-level detection dataset
Per-installation provenance tracking and manual validation flags
evidence_signal: The database contains 1,135,850 installations totaling about 15.01 GWp, and manual review of 1,862 sampled installations estimates overall precision at roughly 74–75% with measurable gains from cross-source corroboration.
watch_item: Precision is still incomplete and depends on source agreement, so downstream analyses should account for residual false positives and source-specific biases.
paper_title: OpenPVMapper: A Multi-source, Nationwide Database of Rooftop Photovoltaic Systems in France
